Hi Jared and Laura —

Thanks for the screenshot, Jared. This looks like the same issue we saw in other accounts where the customer’s secure mail gateway strips or sanitizes <button> elements and inline form handlers from HTML emails. Coupa renders the "Accept" action as a button inside the message body, so when the gateway removes the element the CTA area becomes non-clickable/blank.

Short-term workaround I recommend we try:
1) Laura, send Jared a follow-up email with the full claim URL in plain text (no HTML anchor) and include a one-time claim code in the body. That usually bypasses the gateway rewrite because it becomes a simple URL.
2) Copy the W9 and vendor profile PDF into the email so procurement can start the vendor record and PO while they accept the invite.
3) I’ll file INF-2345 to track a fix/mitigation on our side (we can ask Coupa to send a plain-link fallback in the invite template).

Security note: claim codes are single-use and expire after 72 hours — please avoid posting them in forums. If Acme IT wants an alternate channel, we can also send the code via SMS to a verified procurement contact.

Ben: can you help me check if we have a plain-link option in the Coupa admin UI?

—Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
